description: Power analysis (reduced simulation count) for the observed anchor-hydrophobicity effect, plus the final consolidated per-protein table and power curve
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, math
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

F=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_features.csv"); M=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_core_vs_edge.csv"); W=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_robustness.csv")
sub=F[F.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent'])]
dep=sub[sub.mim_class=='dependent'].GES.values; ind=sub[sub.mim_class=='independent'].GES.values
sd_pool=np.sqrt(((len(dep)-1)*dep.std(ddof=1)**2+(len(ind)-1)*ind.std(ddof=1)**2)/(len(dep)+len(ind)-2))
d_obs=(ind.mean()-dep.mean())/sd_pool
ws=W[W.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent'])]
d2=ws[ws.mim_class=='dependent'].GES_win19.values; i2=ws[ws.mim_class=='independent'].GES_win19.values
sd2=np.sqrt(((len(d2)-1)*d2.std(ddof=1)**2+(len(i2)-1)*i2.std(ddof=1)**2)/(len(d2)+len(i2)-2))
d_free=(i2.mean()-d2.mean())/sd2
print("Cohen's d  UniProt anchor = %.3f   boundary-free 19-mer = %.3f"%(d_obs,d_free))

rng=np.random.default_rng(7); S=800
rows=[]
for n_d in [10,15,20]:
    for n_i in [2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,15,20]:
        minp=2/math.comb(n_d+n_i,n_i)
        if minp>0.05: rows.append(dict(n_dep=n_d,n_ind=n_i,min_p=minp,power_obs=0.0,power_free=0.0,note="p<0.05 unreachable")); continue
        h1=h2=0
        for _ in range(S):
            a=rng.normal(0,1,n_d)
            if stats.mannwhitneyu(rng.normal(d_obs,1,n_i),a,alternative='two-sided').pvalue<0.05: h1+=1
            if stats.mannwhitneyu(rng.normal(d_free,1,n_i),a,alternative='two-sided').pvalue<0.05: h2+=1
        rows.append(dict(n_dep=n_d,n_ind=n_i,min_p=minp,power_obs=h1/S,power_free=h2/S,note=""))
P=pd.DataFrame(rows); P.to_csv("mim_power_analysis.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== Power, two-sided exact Mann-Whitney, alpha=0.05 (800 sims) ===")
print(P.round(3).to_string(index=False))
n80=P[(P.n_dep==10)&(P.power_obs>=0.8)].n_ind
n80f=P[(P.n_dep==10)&(P.power_free>=0.8)].n_ind
print("\nWith 10 clients: 80%% power needs n_independent >= %s at the UniProt-anchor effect, and >= %s at the boundary-free effect."%(
    int(n80.min()) if len(n80) else ">20", int(n80f.min()) if len(n80f) else ">20"))

FIN=M[["gene","acc","topology","mim_class","pmids","anchor","GES","GES_core","GES_edges","GES_win19","KD","Eisenberg","Hessa_dG_sum","muH","GlyPro","anchor_len","Ncharge15","Ccharge15"]].sort_values(["mim_class","GES"])
FIN.to_csv("mim1_client_rule_final_table.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== Final consolidated table (mim1_client_rule_final_table.csv) ===")
print(FIN.round(3).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8,5))
for n_d,c in zip([10,15,20],["#c0392b","#e67e22","#2471a3"]):
    s=P[P.n_dep==n_d].sort_values("n_ind"); ax.plot(s.n_ind,s.power_obs,"o-",color=c,label=f"{n_d} clients, UniProt anchor (d={d_obs:.2f})")
s=P[P.n_dep==10].sort_values("n_ind"); ax.plot(s.n_ind,s.power_free,"s--",color="#7f8c8d",label=f"10 clients, boundary-free anchor (d={d_free:.2f})")
ax.axhline(0.8,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(16.5,0.82,"80% power",fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(3,ls=":",c="grey"); ax.text(3.3,0.04,"current published evidence:\n3 MIM-independent proteins",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("number of experimentally classified MIM-independent outer-membrane proteins")
ax.set_ylabel("power, two-sided exact Mann-Whitney (alpha = 0.05)")
ax.set_title("The published non-client set is too small to test a biophysical rule")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="lower right"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
